module tools.cursor_transition_proof
import v2.compiler.tokenize { LexWalkAcc }
import tools.reference_tokenize { lex_walk_step }
import v2.extdeps.languages.dag { dag_lex_rules }
import v2.std.algebra { fold_list, length }
import extdeps.filesystem.filesystem_io { Filesystem }
import std.process { ProcessExit, ExitSuccess, exit_failure }
type CurrentCount { state: v2.compiler.tokenize.LexWalkAcc, steps: Int }
type ReferenceCount { state: tools.reference_tokenize.LexWalkAcc, steps: Int }
// The truncated list supplies only the iteration count, just as fold_source ignores
// its elements. The state still carries the complete input; no lexical input is split.
fn advance_current(seed: CurrentCount, source: v2.std.text.String, count: Int) -> CurrentCount {
 fold_list(xs: source.take(n: count), empty: seed, cons: fn(acc, _) {
  if acc.state.done { acc } else { CurrentCount { state: v2.compiler.tokenize.lex_walk_step(acc: acc.state), steps: acc.steps + 1 } }
 })
}
fn advance_reference(seed: ReferenceCount, source: v2.std.text.String, count: Int) -> ReferenceCount {
 fold_list(xs: source.take(n: count), empty: seed, cons: fn(acc, _) {
  if acc.state.done { acc } else { ReferenceCount { state: tools.reference_tokenize.lex_walk_step(acc: acc.state), steps: acc.steps + 1 } }
 })
}
fn suffix(source: List<Int>, index: Int) -> List<Int> { source.skip(n: index) }
// The representation relation changes only remaining: source plus scalar index becomes
// the exact suffix. Dispatch is immutable in the legacy walk and reconstructed from
// the same authored rule set; every other state field is retained unchanged.
fn reference_seed(a: v2.compiler.tokenize.LexWalkAcc) -> tools.reference_tokenize.LexWalkAcc {
 tools.reference_tokenize.LexWalkAcc {
 remaining: suffix(source: a.remaining.source, index: a.remaining.index),
 dispatch: tools.reference_tokenize.lex_rule_dispatch(compiled_rules: tools.reference_tokenize.lex_compile_rules(rules: dag_lex_rules().rules)),
 tokens: a.tokens,
 annotations: a.annotations,
 line_prefix_indent_only: a.line_prefix_indent_only,
 pos: a.pos,
 done: a.done,
 error: a.error,
 file: a.file,
 gap_start: a.gap_start,
 gap_has_break: a.gap_has_break,
 layout: a.layout
 }
}
// Compare the complete semantic walk state, including cumulative reversed tokens
// and annotations. Closure-valued dispatch is related by its identical construction,
// rather than by function-object equality across distinct compiler modules.
fn same(a: v2.compiler.tokenize.LexWalkAcc, b: tools.reference_tokenize.LexWalkAcc) -> Bool {
 suffix(source: a.remaining.source, index: a.remaining.index) == b.remaining && a.tokens == b.tokens && a.annotations == b.annotations && a.line_prefix_indent_only == b.line_prefix_indent_only && a.pos == b.pos && a.done == b.done && a.error == b.error && a.file == b.file && a.gap_start == b.gap_start && a.gap_has_break == b.gap_has_break && a.layout == b.layout
}
// At start zero use the genuine legacy initializer. For subsequent intervals,
// prior contiguous interval success establishes this seed by induction. No input
// text is shortened at an interval boundary; legacy matching sees the full suffix.
fn shard(input_path: String, receipt_path: String, start: Int, count: Int, corrupt: Bool) -> ProcessExit {
 let read = Filesystem.Read(path: input_path)
 if !read.success || start < 0 || count < 1 { exit_failure(reason: "invalid shard or unreadable input") } else {
 let source = chars(s: read.content)
 let initial = v2.compiler.tokenize.lex_walk_init(src: source, file: ^comparison, rules: dag_lex_rules())
 let from = advance_current(seed: CurrentCount { state: initial, steps: 0 }, source: source, count: start)
 if from.steps != start || from.state.done { exit_failure(reason: "shard starts beyond EOF") } else {
 let reference = if start == 0 { tools.reference_tokenize.lex_walk_init(src: source, file: ^comparison, rules: dag_lex_rules()) } else { reference_seed(a: from.state) }
 if !same(a: from.state, b: reference) { exit_failure(reason: "initial relation failed") } else {
 let current_end = advance_current(seed: from, source: source, count: count)
 let reference_end = advance_reference(seed: ReferenceCount { state: if corrupt { corrupt_position(a: reference) } else { reference }, steps: start }, source: source, count: count)
 if current_end.steps == reference_end.steps && !current_end.state.error && same(a: current_end.state, b: reference_end.state) {
  let receipt = Filesystem.Write(path: receipt_path, content: "{start} {current_end.steps} {current_end.state.done} {length(xs: current_end.state.tokens)}")
  if receipt.success { ExitSuccess } else { exit_failure(reason: "receipt write failed") }
 } else { exit_failure(reason: "reference transition differs") }
 } }
 }
}

fn main(input_path: String, receipt_path: String, start: String, count: String) -> ProcessExit {
 match parse_int(s: start) {
  Absent => exit_failure(reason: "start is not an integer")
  Present { value: a } => match parse_int(s: count) {
   Absent => exit_failure(reason: "count is not an integer")
   Present { value: n } => shard(input_path: input_path, receipt_path: receipt_path, start: a, count: n, corrupt: false)
  }
 }
}

fn corrupt_position(a: tools.reference_tokenize.LexWalkAcc) -> tools.reference_tokenize.LexWalkAcc {
 tools.reference_tokenize.LexWalkAcc {
 remaining: a.remaining,
 tokens: a.tokens,
 annotations: a.annotations,
 line_prefix_indent_only: a.line_prefix_indent_only,
 pos: a.pos + 1,
 done: a.done,
 error: a.error,
 file: a.file,
 dispatch: a.dispatch,
 gap_start: a.gap_start,
 gap_has_break: a.gap_has_break,
 layout: a.layout
 }
}

// This control corrupts the legacy state after the initial relation check.
// It must fail the transition comparison and must not publish a success receipt.
fn negative(input_path: String, receipt_path: String) -> ProcessExit {
 shard(input_path: input_path, receipt_path: receipt_path, start: 0, count: 1, corrupt: true)
}
